name: MSC JOSSELINE
note: One example, not the best case: ships that joined in Oct 2021 with our estimate within 1 d and the published figure >2 d short ranged 3.3-6.5 d short; this one is mid-range. Across all 122 container-size ships joining in Oct 2021, ours was closer for 52 %; the published figure was short for 60 %; on average it ran 2.5 d short (Sep-Oct). Fuel = gap x 10.1 t/day (anchored >=200 m container ship hotelling, POLA inventory loads, pipeline/emissions.py) x $780/t MGO: what slow steaming instead of idling could have saved if the captain had been told the real wait.
published_d_def: trailing 7-day mean wait of container-size ships that berthed in the 7 days before it joined (what the port quoted)
ours_d_def: ships waiting at the end of the day before it joined / container berthings per day (7-day mean)
